run_ade20k_panoptic_conversion: run the script to convert ADE20K semantic and instance annotations into panoptic segmentation PNGs and JSON
review_ade20k_sem_seg_categories: review the ADE20K_SEM_SEG_CATEGORIES list of 150 semantic segmentation class names used for panoptic conversion
review_palette: review the PALETTE list of 150 RGB color triplets mapped to each ADE20K semantic category
review_stuff_processing: review the stuff region processing loop that creates panoptic masks from semantic segmentation annotations
review_thing_processing: review the thing instance processing loop that creates panoptic masks from instance segmentation annotations
